Image to AI — Convert Images into AI Videos v1.0.0

- Initial release: convert images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into AI-generated videos with transitions and background music.
- No manual video editing or install required — simply upload, describe the video, and receive an MP4 in 30–60 seconds.
- Built-in support for credits, status, and export actions; includes error handling for common issues.
- Session management and authentication are automatic on first use.
- Optimized for marketers and content creators needing quick, professional-looking videos from photos.
